description: Twelve author-adjudicated executable negative controls for the false-paradox normalization gate. Labels are visible to validation code but excluded from QUBO reward and similarity dataflow.

adjudication_protocol.rule: DISSOLVED iff the deterministic observation matches the declared expectation, a non-empty normalization dissolves the apparent tension under a cited authority, and replay passes.

records.title: Binary float sum differs from decimal notation
records.normalization: Binary floating-point values are not exact decimal rationals.

records.title: NaN is unequal to itself
records.normalization: IEEE NaN comparison semantics deliberately make equality false.

records.title: Positive and negative zero compare equal
records.normalization: Numeric equality and representational sign are distinct predicates.

records.title: Floating-point addition is non-associative
records.normalization: Rounded machine addition is not real-number addition.

records.title: Visually identical Unicode strings differ
records.apparent_tension: The same displayed character compares unequal.
records.normalization: Code-point sequences must be normalized before grapheme-level comparison.

records.title: The string False is truthy
records.apparent_tension: A value spelling false converts to true.
records.normalization: String truthiness tests emptiness, not semantic parsing.

records.title: Negative integer division rounds downward
records.apparent_tension: -3 divided by 2 yields -2 instead of truncating to -1.
records.normalization: Python // is floor division and preserves the division identity with modulo.

records.title: Negative dividend has positive modulo
records.normalization: Python remainder follows the divisor sign under floor division.

records.title: JSON tuple returns as a list
records.apparent_tension: Serialization does not preserve a container type.
records.normalization: JSON arrays do not encode the Python tuple/list distinction.

records.title: A second variable changes without assignment
records.apparent_tension: Mutating one list appears to mutate another variable.
records.normalization: Both names reference the same mutable object.

records.title: Decimal arithmetic restores the expected sum
records.apparent_tension: One numeric type makes 0.1 + 0.2 exact while float does not.
records.normalization: Decimal and binary floating-point use different representations and contracts.

records.title: A chained comparison is not an arithmetic chain
records.apparent_tension: Three operands appear to form one comparison operation.
records.normalization: The language defines a comparison chain as adjacent comparisons joined by logical and.
